title: Factor the T360 role count against the 488-replica schedule
body:
## Summary
- The 488-replica schedule is `488 · 9 = 4,392` calls and `4,392 · 408 = 1,791,936` roles, with 437,757 physical families.
- T360 is `360 · 9 · 408 = 1,321,920` roles, with physical stock 323,069.
- The gaps are `1,791,936 − 1,321,920 = 470,016` roles and `437,757 − 323,069 = 114,688` physical families. Partial result. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change.
